status: Strict RFC3339 UTF-8 parsing component; relaxed Serde parsing, Local timezone conversion, production integration and whole-product qualification remain separate gates.

compiler.bootstrap: Explicit Python B0, followed by native HIA B1, B2, B3 and component compilation.

entry.signature: u64 f0(const u8* source, u64 source_len, u8* output, u64 output_capacity, u8* workspace, u64 workspace_len)
entry.status_encoding: Core u32 zero extended to u64 by the fixed native borrowed-buffer wrapper.

caller_preconditions: Advertised source and output ranges are live for the synchronous call, readable for source and writable for output.
Source and output ranges do not overlap, including exact aliasing. Source is not concurrently modified.
No alignment is required. Lengths are actual allocated capacities; invalid pointers or invented capacities are outside the contract.
Zero-length workspace is never read or written. Native retains no pointers and has no mutable global state.
For a valid frame, the payload is valid UTF-8, matching the original Rust &str API. Invalid UTF-8 is outside this component contract; no implicit lossy decoding is performed.

source.byte_order: four little-endian u64 words followed by UTF-8 payload bytes

fields.name: payload_length
fields.required: source length minus 32; byte count, not Unicode character count

source.length_validation: Check that the source has at least 32 bytes, then subtract 32 from its actual size and compare with the declared payload length; never add an untrusted declared length.

output.byte_order: eight little-endian u64 words; signed values use two's-complement bits

fields.name: unix_seconds
fields.value: signed UTC non-leap Unix seconds on success; otherwise 0

fields.name: nanoseconds
fields.value: original timestamp_subsec_nanos, preserving leap fractions; otherwise 0

fields.name: offset_seconds
fields.value: signed FixedOffset local_minus_utc seconds on success; otherwise 0

fields.name: error_kind
fields.value: 0 on success; otherwise the specified original ParseErrorKind code

output.tail: All bytes after offset 64 remain unchanged. Frame and capacity errors leave the entire output unchanged.

semantics.date: Exactly four ASCII year digits, two month digits and two day digits, with Gregorian date validation including year zero.
semantics.separator: ASCII T, t or one space between the date and time; colon separators between two-digit hour, minute and second fields.
semantics.fraction: An optional dot requires at least one ASCII decimal digit. Scale fewer than nine digits to nanoseconds and truncate extra digits while consuming every digit.
semantics.leap_second: Second 60 is accepted on the final second of any minute and becomes second 59 with 1000000000 added to the fraction. No historical leap-second table or carry into the next minute is applied.
semantics.offset: Z or z, or ASCII plus/minus or Unicode U+2212 followed by two hour digits, one colon and two minute digits. Valid offsets are -23:59 through +23:59; no surrounding or trailing whitespace is trimmed.
error_order: fixed date lexical fields, then date range
date/time separator and fixed time lexical fields
fraction lexical scan, then time range
zone lexical fields and minute range
semantics.scope: Value fields and ParseErrorKind are qualified. Relaxed FromStr/Serde parsing, general date-format directives, Local timezone rules, and public Rust error Display adapters are not covered by this component.

status_precedence.condition: output capacity is less than 64, before source or workspace validation
source has fewer than 32 bytes, workspace is nonempty, version is not 1, operation is not 0, declared length differs from actual payload bytes, or the reserved word is nonzero
valid frame; exactly 64 output bytes encode either the original parsed value or original error kind

differential_corpus.controls: Two fills and exact/excess capacities on every semantic case; every shorter output capacity, truncated and oversized frames, invalid metadata and nonempty workspace; all inputs, outputs, tails and guards compared.
